tokens.name: night-900
tokens.usage: Page ground behind every panel. The darkest surface; the map frame and the screen edge.

tokens.name: night-800
tokens.usage: Borders (3px) around panels and cards, ink on paper surfaces, and the inset wells for numbers.

tokens.name: plum-700
tokens.usage: Header bar, the stakeholder board and phone sheets. text-100 and text-300 both pass on it.

tokens.name: plum-600
tokens.usage: Ledger panel and command buttons. The 'wooden' surface one step lighter than plum-700.

tokens.name: paper-100
tokens.usage: Paper cards: lot detail, kawaraban, advisor bubble, the profit-free ledger rows' highlight. Text on it is night-800.

tokens.name: paper-200
tokens.usage: Ledger rows and table stripes on paper. Text on it is night-800.

tokens.name: ema-300
tokens.usage: Ema (votive tablet) cards for stakeholder requests. Text on it is night-800; deadlines use alert-ink.

tokens.name: text-100
tokens.usage: Body text on night, plum and wood surfaces (8.7:1 on plum-600).

tokens.name: text-300
tokens.usage: Secondary text on plum-600 and plum-700: dates, labels, units (6.5:1 or better).

tokens.name: lantern-400
tokens.usage: The one primary action (Advance the month), the selected lot frame, money totals on dark. Ink on it is night-800 (9.1:1).

tokens.name: ours-400
tokens.usage: Our company: lot borders on the map, the top band of command buttons. A graphic colour only, never small text.

tokens.name: ours-200
tokens.usage: Our company as text or numbers on dark (good news, our store count, +%).

tokens.name: rival-400
tokens.usage: The rival's lot borders on the map and rival markers. Graphic only.

tokens.name: rival-200
tokens.usage: The rival as text or numbers on dark (their store count, warnings about them).

tokens.name: alert-ink
tokens.usage: Warnings and deadlines printed on paper-100 (5.8:1).

tokens.name: alert-ink-deep
tokens.usage: Deadlines on ema-300 cards, where alert-ink is too light (5.3:1).

tokens.name: neutral-400
tokens.usage: Lot borders of neighbourhood shops that belong to nobody in the game. Graphic only.

families.body: "Zen Maru Gothic", "Hiragino Maru Gothic ProN", "Hiragino Sans", sans-serif

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Company name in the header; sheet titles on phones.

styles.name: heading
styles.sample: お品書き　先月の勘定

styles.name: body
styles.sample: 物流センターから2マスの配送圏に店をまとめると、配送費が下がります。
styles.usage: Advisor lines, request text, sheet body. The phone minimum for reading text.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: 坂本龍馬社長「来月には看板を上げる」
styles.usage: Secondary lines and button sub-labels. Never smaller than 12px.

styles.name: figure-lg
styles.usage: The one figure a panel is about (profit, cash).

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Ledger rows, header chips, costs on buttons.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Lot names, stakeholder names with support, phase pills.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: The pixel-grid unit. Gaps inside a chip; the step every other value is a multiple of.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps between rows in a card; padding of chips and small buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding; gaps between cards in a column.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen gutter on every width; panel padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gaps between the main columns on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Ledger rows and lot tags: barely rounded, like cut paper.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, command buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Advisor bubbles and the top corners of phone sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Header chips and the phase pill.

tokens.name: tile
tokens.usage: One map lot and one MCH sprite at 1x. Sprites are never scaled to any other size.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Smallest tap target on every width.

tokens.name: bar-header
tokens.usage: Header bar height (desktop and phone).

tokens.name: bar-dock-phone
tokens.usage: Phone bottom dock: Commands + Advance the month.

tokens.name: row-fold
tokens.usage: One collapsed row of a phone accordion (ledger, voices, approvals).

tokens.name: bp-tablet
tokens.usage: From this width: two columns (map + one stacked side column).

tokens.name: bp-desktop
tokens.usage: From this width: the three-column desk (ledger, map, voices).

tokens.name: border-panel
tokens.usage: Every panel and card outline, in night-800. Matches the near-black sprite outline.

tokens.name: border-band
tokens.usage: Owner band on top of command buttons and lot frames on the map.
